serverInfo.title: Gachi Data API — Japan life & safety data
serverInfo.description: 9 tools for Japan life & safety data: semantic station discovery (9,035 stations — ramen density, accessibility, official hazard), station restrooms & accessibility (526 Tokyo stations), live train status, JMA flood/landslide alerts, hazard risk and official statistics for any station or municipality. Government open data, no auth.
